_comment: Hotkeyed abilities (issue #7). Heroes list theirs in data/heroes.json under abilities (up to 4, keys 1-4). short: label on the touch button. cost: Ink spent. cooldown: seconds before it can be used again. kind picks the code in scripts/abilities.gd: heal (patch everyone in radius, optional shield that soaks damage), arc (wide weapon swing: damage, reach, arc = degrees either side of facing, knock), dash (rush forward distance px, hitting everything on the way), taunt (pull enemies in radius onto the user for time s and cut the user's damage taken by guard), bolt (throw count blades spread degrees apart: damage, speed, range px, pierce), vanish (out of sight for time s: nearby enemies in radius lose track, speed multiplier, next landed swing deals crit times damage), drain (damage enemies in radius, then heal allies within heal_radius by heal_ratio of the damage taken, up to heal_cap each), mark (enemies in radius take mult times damage for time s), parry (for time s the next hit taken is cancelled and the nearest enemy to its source within reach takes damage, is stunned, and refund Ink comes back). arc and dash can also stun (seconds; bosses only flinch). ai: when an ally uses it on its own. windup = an enemy within 'range' is winding up an attack on the user; self_hurt = the user is below 'below' HP with an enemy within 'range'; hurt = someone in radius below 'below' HP; crowd = at least 'count' enemies within 'range' of the user; target = its target is within 'range'; threat = at least 'count' enemies within 'range' of the leader. Issue #9 adds player-set presets on top.

rewrite.name: Rewrite
rewrite.desc: Ash writes the party a little less hurt: heals everyone nearby for 10 and adds an 8-point shield for 6 s.

strikethrough.name: Strikethrough
strikethrough.desc: A quick line through the page: dash forward and cut everything in the way. Gets you out of trouble, too.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.desc: Red Ink up the arm, then a huge axe arc in front of Bran that hurls Nibblers back.

hold_the_line.name: Hold the Line
hold_the_line.desc: Clause four. Every Nibbler nearby goes for Bran instead, and he takes half damage for 5 s.

poultice_toss.name: Poultice Toss
poultice_toss.desc: A fistful of something warm and green for everyone nearby: heals 16. Do not ask what is in it.

scald.name: Scald
scald.desc: Hot broth in a full circle. Shoves everything off her.

long_thrust.name: Long Thrust
long_thrust.desc: Pike first, Daro second: a long lunge that skewers a line of enemies.

pike_sweep.name: Pike Sweep
pike_sweep.desc: The shaft, not the point: a wide sweep that clears room.

chucking_out.name: Chucking Out
chucking_out.desc: Shoulder first through whatever is in the way. Everything she hits goes flying and sees stars.

last_orders.name: Last Orders
last_orders.desc: Both fists into the floor. Everything around her is stunned for 2 s. Time, gentlemen.

knife_fan.name: Knife Fan
knife_fan.desc: Three knives in a fan, from a long way off. Nobody saw where they came from.

lamps_out.name: Lamps Out
lamps_out.desc: Smoke and a wink. For 3 s enemies lose her, she moves faster, and her next hit does double damage.

levy.name: Levy
levy.desc: Everything nearby pays 8. The party nearby gets most of it back as health.

audit.name: Audit
audit.desc: Odile opens the ledger on everything nearby. For 6 s they take 50% more damage from everyone.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.desc: En garde for a heartbeat. The next blow is turned aside and answered: 22 damage and a stun. A clean parry refunds the Ink.

fleche.name: Fleche
fleche.desc: A running lunge, point first. Hits hard and carries her through the line.
